name: roof-embedded
notes: Roof case that fits under a SOLID roof layer: target T [0,5,0] with bedrock on every side and above (roof slab y 5..7). Everything else is in the layer below. A = swap piston [0,4,0] under T, facing down (retracted at rest). Its only power is quasi-connectivity through B2 [1,5,0], T's neighbour bedrock, strongly powered from below by an observer C [1,4,0] facing down (output up into B2). An observer switches with flags 2 and updates only the block in front of its output and that block's neighbours (B2, T...), never A: A loses its power silently. Per cycle: the trigger cell [1,3,0] (watched by C) changes; 2 ticks later C turns on (A quasi-powered, silent) and U [0,4,-3] pushes a stone from [0,4,-2] toward [0,4,-1] (beside A): the push updates A while powered, A extends; 2 ticks later C turns off (silent) and the stone LANDS beside A in the block-entity phase: A extended, unpowered, updated after the block events = armed for the next window. The player's press there (break A, place a piston facing UP at T) leaves a piston whose queued retract runs unpowered and removes T. Unswapped, A just retracts and the next cycle re-extends it.
